title: Our new SaaS app Figma is being blocked by the firewall
description: The design team can't access Figma; they get 'Connection refused'. There's no issue on an external network.

worklogs.description: Obtained Figma's official IP/DNS list and added the vendor documentation.
Opened firewall change request CR-2826, awaiting approval.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The CR approval time is 4 hours, I'm following up. As soon as it's approved, outbound 443 will be opened.
